post_update_notes: Nothing manual required — RolesSeeder/SettingsSeeder/TaxRatesSeeder/CmsFooterPagesSeeder now run automatically as part of every update, backfilling the new bulk-update-products permissions, the Country-Based VAT toggle, starting EU/EEA VAT rates, and the returns-policy/shipping-information footer pages without touching anything you've already customized. Verify every seeded tax rate before enabling Country-Based VAT on the Tax Settings page — they're a documented starting point, not a live feed. If your shipping zone has zero countries assigned, open it in the admin and click "Add All EU/EEA Countries" (Countries tab) instead of re-running ShippingZonesAndMethodsSeeder, which truncates and rebuilds your whole shipping setup. Running Nginx? Copy deploy/nginx/oeparts.conf and deploy/php-fpm/oeparts-pool-overrides.conf — see README's "Web server" section. Git-managed installs can now apply this update directly from Apply Update (git fetch/checkout + composer install) instead of updating manually via SSH.
